Read more about our product

Read more about our product Eucerin® DermatoClean Cleansing Gel is a mild & effective facial cleanser that thoroughly yet gently cleanses, eliminates excess sebum and removes impurities and make up. The formula with Hyaluronic Acid and other moisturizing ingredients does not dry out the skin. The formula supports a healthy skin barrier and maintains skin's pH level. Free of fragrance.

How to Use

Apply morning and evening on a wet face. Lather and gently massage with fingertips. Rinse off thoroughly. Wet your face, neck and décolleté. Lather in your palm and gently massage in with fingertips. Rinse off thoroughly.

Clinical Formula

Hyaluronic acid

Hyaluronic Acid is formed by skin cells and is part of the connective tissue of the skin. One of its key functions is to retain moisture, and it has the ability to bind in between 1,000 and 10,000 times its own weight in water (i.e. one gram binds between one and ten liters). As we age, the skin's natural ability to produce Hyaluronic Acid depletes and wrinkles start to form and deepen.

FAQ

Why is exfoliation important?

Exfoliation, through chemical or physical means, is the removal process of excess corneocyte buildup. It stimulates cell turnover and results in a more polished, smoother, translucent surface.
